prompt: Create a production pixel-art sprite animation atlas for Bullets of Fury. Reference is our actual in-game neutral drone, a dark steel/chromium cyclopean mechanical alien with angular armored crown and green single eye. Design its NEW DRACODIA POSSESSION DRONE variant, an evil code-alien UFO: a small broad hovering disc with that same angular spiked steel crown/face and a single sinister RED central eye, black chrome armor with purple circuitry, magenta data veins, small silver pointed outer fins. No humanoid arms or legs. Looks like that reference core evolved into a sinister alien flying saucer, readable 16-bit Neo-Geo sprite pixels, limited deliberate metallic highlights, heavy dark pixel outlines. Deliver a strict 4 by 4 contact sheet of sixteen consecutive animated frames on a transparent background, equal square cells, generous identical transparent padding and consistent center/pivot, no overlap. Frame1 front view floating, next frames gently bank left and pitch, sweep back to front and bank right, smoothly loop to the same front pose at frame16. It must look like a physical UFO hovering, NOT a flat rotated symbol. Keep the exact same disc/crown geometry and single eye in every frame. The eye and underside aperture charge a bright red/white data-bomb energy pulse through frames8-12; several tiny red digital glyph-like light pixels appear on the armor. Every frame shows the full entire disc without crop, same usable sprite size. No text, no labels, no panel borders, no ground, no drop shadow, no background, no gradient. This is an auxiliary villain infector that flies out of a red portal, not a player ship.
